result.quote: “O altar, O altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.’”
result.reason: The key is supported by the statement that human bones will be burned on the altar. However, the question broadly asks what the man cries, and his cry also announces Josiah’s birth and the sacrifice of the priests. It should specify that it is asking what will be burned upon the altar.
